additional_findings.failure_scenario: Human-mode `list --state failed` with no matching jobs prints the pre-existing empty-table text 'No active jobs.' plus 'Use --all to view finished history.' The message does not mention the filter, so it can read as if no jobs exist at all. Criterion 4 asks for unchanged format restricted to matching jobs, which this satisfies; it is a wording nuance, not a failure.
additional_findings.source_evidence: render() chooses the empty message purely from records.is_empty() and `all`; visible_jobs filters before print_table, so a filtered-to-empty list hits the same branch.

additional_findings.failure_scenario: The large filter test seeds finished_at_ms = now-100ms and then performs roughly 35 CLI invocations (each runs prune, scans and probes three active records with a non-existent ctl.sock, which fails immediately). If the whole sequence exceeded 30 s on a very slow host, the five-recent-window assertions would fail. Separately, `observed_stopped` relies on the finished template's guardian pgid having no live members; a reused pgid would flip its displayed state. Both are improbable; the supplied test run passed.
additional_findings.source_evidence: select_visible window is `now - time < 30_000` (src/main.rs:374); store.observed_record_until probes ctl.sock then checks group_is_absent(guardian_pid) (src/store.rs:441-456). Existing tests already use the same template/guardian pattern (tests/lifecycle.rs:1661-1686), so this is consistent with repository practice.
additional_findings.proposed_reproducer: Run `cargo test list_state_filter_matches_displayed_state` under heavy CPU contention and check for window-related assertion failures; not expected to fail in normal conditions.
